introduction: Hello. I'm	from Commercial Analysts Co., a national public opinion firm (calling long distance from New York). We're doing an opinion survey and I'd like to ask you a few brief questions.

A.question: Do you or does anyone in your household smoke cigarettes?

B.question: Please tell me the first name and sex of everyone in your home who smokes cigarettes

C.question: Can you tell me the regular brand of cigarettes (PERSON NAMED) smokes most often?

instructions_to_interviewer:
1. IF NO MERIT SMOKERS TERMINATE. IF RESPONDENT SMOKES MERIT CONTINUE WITH Q. 2a.
2. IF RESPONDENT DOES NOT SMOKE MERIT, SELECT A FAMILY MEMBER WHO DOES BY SAYING
	"We have to select smokers at random in a household. In your home we'd like to speak with (NAME OF MERIT SMOKER). Is he/she at home now?" If desired respondent is at home ask to speak with him/her and after repeating the introduction continue with Q. 1.
3. IF DESIRED MERIT SMOKER IS NOT AT HOME AT PRESENT TIME, LEARN WHEN SMOKER WILL BE AT HOME; RECORD BELOW; AND CALL BACK AT THAT TIME.
